## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. The save banner reads what `parseError` already parsed

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-01T11:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p2.** It was measured: a save that the spec refuses, served by the HTTP dispatcher, shows `[object Object]` and an empty field path, so the author cannot see what to fix.

**Direction.** `ResourceEditPage`'s refusal branch reads `err.message` and `err.issues`, which `MetadataClient.parseError` already builds from all three envelope shapes. ⛔ No second parse of the envelope in the page. **Pins:** the dispatcher shape and the REST shape each render the server's message and field path. A non-422 error is the control.

- No open PR touches `metadata-admin/`. The open PRs are objectui#11390, objectui#11391 and objectui#11392 (this seat; `types` / `plugin-detail` / `plugin-view` / `core` / `components` / `react`, plus `app-shell`'s `ActionParamDialog.tsx`, a different file), objectui#11069 (a parked draft on `packages/cli/**` and docs) and objectui#5400.
- PR objectui#11382 (the page editor's save body) merged as `3ae919307` and did not change `ResourceEditPage.tsx`.
- No other `pm:dispatched` claim names these files.

Ruling: triage `5930783049`, verbatim where it binds: "`ResourceEditPage`'s refusal branch reads `err.message` and `err.issues`, which `MetadataClient.parseError` already builds from all three envelope shapes. ⛔ No second parse of the envelope in the page. **Pins:** the dispatcher shape and the REST shape each render the server's message and field path. A non-422 error is the control."
Scope: the PR says `Fixes #11379`.
`Clause-②: no`. Why: an error banner reads the already-parsed error. No accept set, export, prop or type changes.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#11394 (`Fixes #11379`), head `dece54887b`

`domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01JG2jy8a9su7ia4Hx7zxv42` · 2026-10-01T17:36Z. Claim `5935942772`, dev report `5936780023`. Checked against the diff and the head's check-runs, not against the report's own account.

| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| shape | Draft, base `main`. The first line is `Fixes #11379` and the second is `Clause-②: no`. No other closing keyword appears in the body. 6 files, +339 / −33. NOT GOVERNED |
| the ruling (`5930783049`) | `ResourceEditPage`'s save `catch` reads `parsedIssues = err.issues` for the 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` dialog and the 422 / `INVALID_METADATA` mapping, and `err.message` for the flat-string fallback. `EmbeddedItemEditor`'s 422 branch reads `err.issues`. No `err.body` read remains at the three sites, no envelope is parsed in the page, no formatter is added, and the producer (`parseError`) is unchanged |
| reds before the change | measured through the real components, with errors built by a real `MetadataClient` from wire bodies. 422 on the dispatcher shape: the Save title read "fix  before saving.", and the banner and the issue row read `[object Object]`. 409: the dialog listed nothing. Embedded: "Validation failed (0 issues).". All green on both shapes after (18 / 18). The REST shape and a non-422 error are the controls |
| forced test surface | the embedded editor's pins are a new file, `EmbeddedItemEditor.refusalIssues-11379.test.tsx`: no existing embedded suite drives a save. `ResourceEditPage.docEditor-10188.test.tsx`'s refusal fixture (`body.issues` with no parsed issues, a shape the parser never produces) was rebuilt through the real parser, because this change turned it red. Both are test-only |
| `Clause-②: no`, confirmed | an error banner reads the already-parsed error; no accept set, export, prop or type moves |
| changeset prose (seat, sentence by sentence, under the maintainer's ruling in objectstack-ai/objectstack#21187) | `.changeset/11379-refused-save-reads-parsed-error.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch. Every sentence matches the measured reds and the diff |
| CI | head `dece54887b`: 43 check-runs. 40 `success`, including `Lint`, `Type Check`, all eight `Test` shards and `Spec Main Shape Gate`. 3 expected skips: `Test (coverage)`, its unexpanded matrix placeholder, and `dependabot`. 0 failure. Mergeable `clean` |

**Out-of-scope findings, one line each** (each is in the PR's Acceptance notes):
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`'s 409 branch reads `err.body.issues`, the same mechanism. It is dormant: the server's destructive-change gate runs only for `object` saves → Acceptance notes.
- The destructive dialog reads `kind` / `path` while the producer's issues carry `code` / `field`, so rows head "change" with no field line. This was read at source, with no public-door measurement → Acceptance notes.
- The embedded editor's 0-issue 422 drops `err.message`. It behaves the same on both shapes and is not this card's defect → Acceptance notes.

**Landing.** Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the fleet relay. On MERGED, the seat verifies the change by content, closes the card with a close note if `Fixes` leaves it open, and strips `pm:dispatched`.
